messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] P1 — Inference error spike detected in us-east-prod. Error rate >25% for model rdx-3-medium over 3m. Pager sent to oncall.

maria: alert received. seeing customer error reports, opening war room and pulling logs. war room: https://redwood.zoom.us/j/123456789 :rotating_light:

oncall-sre: joining war room now. I'll own initial triage until an incident lead is assigned.

eli: I can take incident lead. setting up incident channel #war-room-4211112222 and coordinating comms.

tara: on logs. pulling deploy history and recent autoscaler changes.

raj: FYI last infra change was autoscaler tweak at 03:15 UTC. flagging it as potential vector.

oncall-sre: don't rollback blindly. need scope + a sample error. can someone paste a concise log excerpt?

tara: sample log:
```
2026-03-17T03:19:12Z ERROR inference svc: handler.go:242 kv-cache miss, model=rdx-3-medium request_id=abc123 code=500 trace=...
```

maria: quick customer-impact summary: some generation requests are failing/timeouting. estimated ~2% of active requests affected; concentrated on power-user workloads hitting long-context paths.

eli: drafting status page update now. proposed text:
"Investigating elevated error rates for text generation in us-east. Engineers are triaging; some requests may fail or time out. We will provide updates every 15 minutes."

sam: small tweak: add a short workaround: "retry/backoff" and set cadence to 15m. also include link to war room for internal teams.

raj: I pushed a fallback route to rdx-3-small on low-latency paths as a temporary mitigation (need config approval to keep). reduces quality but avoids failures.

oncall-sre: @raj thanks — can you share the config diff and restart plan in the war room? we'll validate traffic steering.

tara: collecting traces and KV cache metrics now. initial hypothesis: cache eviction + autoscaler interplay causing transient 500s on warm-up.

maria: who's posting externally? eli you're lead on comms, confirm and I'll amplify to CSMs.

eli: acknowledged — I'll post to status.redwood.io and send a templated customer message. draft customer note:
"We are investigating elevated error rates impacting text generation for customers in the us-east region. Our engineers are working on a mitigation; next update in 15 minutes. For immediate relief, switching to eu-west endpoints or using the rdx-3-small fallback can reduce errors. We apologize for the disruption."

sam: I'll send the targeted customer DM to customers with active incidents and include the workaround instructions.

oncall-sre: runbook checklist snippet: `/runbooks/inference/production-eviction-checks` — steps 1-5 underway (cache stats, model process health, recent deploy diff, autoscaler metrics, fallback routing).

eli: adding severity=P1 and war room link to the status entry. will post now and set 15m reminders.

tara: next triage sync + logs share in +10m. I'll update with KV hit/miss ratio and queue latency.

oncall-sre: confirm assignments: incident lead=eli, triage=oncall-sre & tara, mitigation=fallback (raj/sam). comms=eli.

maria: noted. please don't resolve until 2h of stable error rates after mitigation. include RCA owner assignment in final update.

incident-bot: Incident created: id=4211112222, severity=P1, war_room=https://redwood.zoom.us/j/123456789, assigned=[eli,oncall-sre], pageresolved=false.

eli: thanks all. I'll post external update in 2m and keep the 15m cadence. if anyone needs a handoff for the 08:00 shift, call it out here and I'll arrange handover.

oncall-sre: joining war room and starting heap/profile runs. will report findings in 10m.

maria: thanks team — keep updates short and timeboxed in the channel.
